scope: Intermediate read-path comparison. Final block/range, offset and full conformance qualification remain pending.
sourceAttribution: The two immutable deployed bundles were measured with the same expanded driver. Initial seeding overlapped a brief range-only regression recheck. The measured reads ran after that recheck. Neither run overlapped the earlier broad regression suite.

broadRegression.failure: New range test was loaded into a process already using the previous adapter. getRange was missing on that cached module.

limits: Latency distributions vary across routed instances and ingress. Client tail latency did not improve uniformly. No capacity or sustained-load qualification is claimed.
Metrics in response headers cover work until response headers, rather than the full SSE body lifetime.
Cache-disabled requests create a separate server within the reached isolate. They are distinct from a newly started isolate.
Current replay still fetches complete objects. The bounded range adapter and block codec are groundwork for the next integration milestone.
